text:
sarah: Heads-up: planning a coord for region/edge routing policy v3 rollout to eu-west and apac-edge in ~30m (11:00 UTC). This is the routing policy that prefers local-edge -> regional-fallback -> global. Who can be on deploy and smoke checks?

mike: I can be on deploy. I'll handle the smoke checks for eu-west. Do we have TTL lowered for the DNS entries?

raj: lowered TTL to 60s about 10m ago. Verified on Route53 for eu-west and apac-edge.

leo: I'll monitor logs & SLO dashboards. Can we do a canary to eu-west at 5% first? Last time we hit cache-warm issues when we jumped 50% immediately.

jen: 5% canary sounds good. I also want a quick code-review ping for the policy diff — added edge-failover order + weighted-routes. ping @sarah when you start so I can eyeball traces.

sarah: plan: kickoff at 11:00 UTC -> canary eu-west 5% -> 15m smoke -> if ok ramp to 25% -> 10m -> 50% -> final. apac will start after eu-west reaches 50% (approx +40m). rollback if error rate > 0.5% or latency p95 > baseline + 120ms.

mike: Smoke checklist (quick):
- curl health from edge: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://eu-west.edge.redwood.ai/health`
- run small load: `hey -n 1000 -c 25 https://eu-west.edge.redwood.ai/ping`
- check KV cache hitrate (console -> infra -> edge-caches)
- check traces service name: `edge-routing`

raj: adding infra checks: verify firewall egress rules for apac-edge still allow cache-sync ports. I already ran `gcloud compute firewall-rules list --filter="name~'edge-cache'"` and it's fine.

deploy-bot: @sarah deploy plan created: routing-policy/v3 -> targets [eu-west-edge, apac-edge]. Canary: eu-west 5%. Job id: dp-20250313-01.

leo: re: metrics, I'll watch `ingress.latency.p95`, `api.errors.rate` and `edge.cache.hitrate`. I have a dashboard pinned: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/edge-rollout

jen: small nit: in the YAML we changed `fallback_order` to `[local, regional, global]` — just confirming everyone is okay with that semantics? It's required for GDPR-locality in EU.

sarah: yes that's intentional. also added `max_retry=2` for regional fallback to avoid thundering herd.

mike: I'm ready. lowered TTL confirmed, smoke steps scripted in the runbook. Who will flip traffic percentages in the router-control plane?

raj: I will. I'll run the routing change with this CLI snippet:

```
redwoodctl routing set-policy --id routing-policy/v3 --target eu-west-edge --weight 5
```

and then monitor with:
```
redwoodctl routing status --target eu-west-edge --watch
```

leo: if anything spikes we abort and run rollback: `redwoodctl routing rollback --job dp-20250313-01`

deploy-bot: dp-20250313-01 status: queued.

sarah: starting now. @mike start smoke tools, @leo watch dashboards, @raj execute traffic change when I say go. Jen you'll be on traces.

raj: executing in 5..4..3.. go

deploy-bot: dp-20250313-01 step: set-weight eu-west-edge=5% -> success (timestamp 1752457245)

mike: smoke run: `curl` health returned 200 0.037s, hey load completed 1000 reqs median 48ms, no 5xx. cache hitrate looks ~82%.

leo: dashboards steady. ingress.latency.p95 at baseline + 18ms, errors 0.08% — under threshold.

jen: traces look clean, no new error classes. sampling shows normal KV-misses but within expected.

sarah: ramp to 25% now

raj: set-weight eu-west-edge=25% -> success (timestamp 1752457602)

mike: quick load again: 2k reqs, p95 still +25ms, errors 0.12%

leo: holding for 10m to watch heatmap. so far good.

deploy-bot: dp-20250313-01 step: set-weight eu-west-edge=50% -> success (timestamp 1752458400)

leo: eu-west at 50%, p95 +40ms, errors 0.2% — still below 0.5%.

sarah: starting apac-edge canary 5%

raj: set-weight apac-edge=5% -> success (timestamp 1752458801)

mike: apac smoke ok from our probe in syd (200 0.12s).

leo: monitoring apac dashboard: cache hitrate a bit lower (~74%) but latency acceptable. We'll watch for 20m before ramp.

jen: quick note: updated the runbook with the exact rollback commands + contact list in case paging. link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/edge-rollout-runbook

deploy-bot: dp-20250313-01 status: completed. final weights: eu-west-edge=50%, apac-edge=25%, global-fallback=25%.

sarah: Nice work team. Post-mortem: none needed, small telemetry bump but within SLOs. I'll follow up with a short RFC to make max_retry configurable per region. :tada:

leo: filing a quick perf note in ops-log.

mike: leaving a short note in #incidents just in case anyone searches.

jen: thanks all. I'll close the code review after CI merges the policy change.

raj: back to normal ops.
